package internal

// legal: `if err == nil` is not the graceful-nil anti-pattern; it's the
// standard error-handling shape. The matcher's looksLikeError suffix filter
// excludes this.
func doWork() error {
	var err error
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return err
}

// legal: `if cfg == nil` is a bare-ident nil-check — when NilGuard is in
// ReceiverFieldOnly mode (the default in walkers), this is NOT flagged.
func parseConfig(cfg interface{}) {
	if cfg == nil {
		return
	}
}
